'''Kufra Ahara''' was a [[Murachaun]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who was skilled in modifications of spacecraft. Her work on the ships of the [[Sanjin Green Hawks]] allowed them to take [[Laakteen Depot]], and she was even granted access to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Ahara liked to pull practical jokes on her pilots, but they tolerated her, considering that she would spend whole nights tweaking their fighters to keep them in top condition.<ref name="Geonosis" />
